summary: Acceptance plan for warehouse order allocation and inventory reservation implementing atomic reservations, priority-based fulfillment, idempotent order ID tracking, and input immutability.

requirements.description: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be aggregated before checking stock.

sources.quote: Reserve all lines of an order together or reserve nothing; repeated SKU lines must be added together before checking stock.

acceptance.given: An initial stock inventory and an order with multiple lines, including repeated SKUs
acceptance.when: Stock is reserved for the order
acceptance.then: All SKU quantities are aggregated and checked, and stock is either fully deducted for all lines or unchanged if insufficient or invalid

requirements.description: Expedited orders must be allocated stock before normal orders, while arrival order within each priority level is preserved.

sources.quote: Expedited orders get stock before normal orders; preserve arrival order within each priority.

acceptance.given: A sequence of orders containing both expedited and normal priorities competing for stock
acceptance.then: All valid expedited orders are processed first in arrival order, followed by valid normal orders in arrival order

requirements.description: Order IDs must be idempotent such that only the first occurrence of an order ID is processed, and any subsequent duplicate occurrences are completely ignored.

sources.quote: An order ID is idempotent: process only its first occurrence and ignore later duplicates.

acceptance.given: An orders list containing multiple occurrences of the same order ID
acceptance.then: Only the first occurrence claims the ID and is evaluated, while subsequent occurrences of that ID are ignored entirely

requirements.description: Invalid order lines and invalid order attributes must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects unmutated.

sources.quote: Invalid order lines must be rejected without changing stock, and callers must retain their original input objects.

acceptance.given: Stock inventory and orders containing invalid lines or invalid order attributes
acceptance.then: Invalid orders and lines are rejected with appropriate reasons, stock is unmodified for failed reservations, and input objects remain unmutated

assumptions: Stock SKU keys must be nonempty strings with nonnegative safe-integer quantities; invalid stock throws a TypeError.
Orders must be supplied as an array; non-array orders input throws a TypeError.
An identifiable first occurrence with an invalid priority is rejected with reason invalid_order and still claims its ID.
Orders with missing or invalid IDs are rejected with id null and reason invalid_order.
Orders rejected as invalid_order are recorded first in input order, followed by reservation failures in processing order.
Failed reservations do not consume stock, and inputs are never mutated.
